meta.titleDefault: RESHAPE Dhahran — Calisthenics club and training programs for adults and kids
meta.description: RESHAPE Dhahran: calisthenics, HYROX and CrossFit, with a program of your own and a community that pushes you forward. Meet the club and the Success Partners offer.

common.conceptNote: Concept visualization — details may change before opening.

hero.title: Your strength starts here
hero.sub: A training club in Dhahran that brings calisthenics, HYROX and CrossFit together — with a program of your own and a community that pushes you forward.
hero.stage: The club is in its pre-opening stage.

about.title: More than a gym. A way of life.
about.body: RESHAPE Dhahran is a place for serious training with a community spirit: several sports to choose from, a program built for you, and coaches who stay with you until you reach your goal.

one.d: More than one sport under one roof.

two.d: A plan that starts from your level and goal.

three.d: People who push you, and people who guide you.

sports.title: Choose the sport that suits you
sports.body: Each sport has its own character and aim. Try them, then pick what feels like you — or combine them.
sports.kids: And kids have programs of their own

program.title: A program built for you
program.body: Don't train on someone else's plan. We start from your level and goal and build a clear program, so you know what you are doing in every session and why.

items.two: A clear goal and defined steps
items.three: Follow-up and adjustment as you progress

hybrid.title: Hybrid: sport as a way of life
hybrid.body: For those who want it all: a considered mix of the three sports — calisthenics, HYROX and CrossFit — that takes you to your athletic goal and makes training part of your day.
hybrid.tag: A mix of the three sports

zone.title: Bring out the warrior in you
zone.body: The training zone is designed around the warrior character: a place that pushes you to bring out your best.

one.d: Train among people who share your goal.

two.d: Learn from those ahead of you and help those who follow.

three.d: You always know your next step.

four.d: With you until you reach your goal.

juice.title: A sports juice bar, steps from your workout
juice.body: Your drinks before and after training, sports snacks and refreshing drinks — close by when you need them.

facilities.title: Details that match you
facilities.body: We care about our facilities as much as the training: restrooms, changing rooms and lockers designed for comfort and calm.

kids.metaDescription: Kids programs at RESHAPE Dhahran: movement, balance, coordination and age-appropriate strength foundations. Enquiries are made by a parent or guardian.
kids.title: Movement first, then strength
kids.howTitle: What does a session look like?

one.d: Running, jumping and movement games that prepare the body and break the ice.

two.d: Balance, hanging or floor movement — at a progression that suits the group.

three.d: One new attempt, so the child leaves knowing they moved forward.

kids.howNote: A general description of the coaching approach. The schedule and age groups will be announced before opening.
kids.dataBody: When you register interest we ask only for the guardian’s name and mobile number. We do not ask for the child’s name, date of birth or any health information.

football.metaDescription: Physical preparation for football players at RESHAPE Dhahran: strength, conditioning, mobility and movement quality, and return-to-play preparation within clear limits.

one.d: Leave your name and number. Do not send any medical information.

two.d: We learn your position, your season and your goal.

three.d: We explain what can be offered once the program format is confirmed.

privacy.metaDescription: How the RESHAPE Dhahran website handles the information you send through the interest form.
privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.draft: Draft — not final. No real data is collected through this site in production until this notice is approved and a responsible contact is named.

s1.p: This website belongs to RESHAPE Dhahran, part of the RESHAPE brand (commercial registration {cr} as shown on the official store). The entity responsible for the data and its contact details are to be confirmed by RESHAPE management before launch.

items.a: The adult’s name and mobile number.
items.b: The program you are interested in, the type of request, and your notes if you write any.
items.c: The page language and the zone or page you started from (non-personal identifiers).
items.d: Your choice about marketing messages, the time of submission and the version of this notice.

s3.p: We do not ask for a child’s name or date of birth, national ID, health or medical information, payment details or an email address. We do not store your IP address with your request. Please do not write sensitive information in the notes field.

s4.p: To respond to your request and contact you about the program you chose. We send marketing messages only if you agree in a separate box, and you can withdraw at any time.

s5.t: Where it is kept and who sees it
s5.p: Requests are stored in a database dedicated to this site and are seen only by authorised RESHAPE staff. We do not sell your data or share it for advertising. The hosting provider and storage location will be stated here once the production environment is approved.

s6.p: The proposed period is 90 days from the request, after which it is deleted unless you become a member or ask otherwise. This is a proposal subject to approval by RESHAPE management.

s7.p: You can ask to see, correct or delete your data, or withdraw your consent to marketing messages.

privacy.s7pending: The contact for privacy requests will be published here before launch. Until then, RESHAPE’s official WhatsApp can be used.

s8.p: The site currently uses no analytics or advertising trackers and no non-essential cookies. Your “Simple view” preference for the tour is stored in your browser only.

s9.p: Payment and subscription take place in the official RESHAPE store (reshape-sa.com), which has its own policies. This website does not process payments.

privacy.legal: This notice describes what the site actually does. It is not a legal compliance certification.
